note: Re-judged 2026-09-27 by TOOL-4 after the row's citation moved from §8 to §D.2, the annex subsection the heading reader now reads; the text and the tagged units are unchanged since QF-2 judged them the same day, so QF-2's reading stands. Forbidden: several transmit passwords, or a receive set of one. TestRFC1195OneTransmitPasswordManyReceivePasswords asserts sign key 1 only and a receive set of two that verifies both; TestRFC1195KeyOutsideReceiveSetRefused asserts a key outside the set is refused and the transmit key alone does not verify a key-2 PDU. Enforced.
